paragraphs.sourceText: Questions 26 to 35 are based on the following passage.

paragraphs.sourceText: The ocean is heating up. That's the conclusion of a new study that finds that Earth's oceans now 26 heat at twice the rate they did 18 years ago. Around half of ocean heat intake since 1865 has taken place since 1997, researchers report online in Nature Climate Change.
paragraphs.translationZh: 海洋正在变暖。这是一项新研究的结论，该研究发现地球海洋现在吸收热量的速度是 18 年前的两倍。研究人员在《自然·气候变化》在线版上报告称，自 1865 年以来，大约一半的海洋热量摄入发生在 1997 年之后。

paragraphs.sourceText: Warming waters are known to 27 to coral bleaching (珊瑚白化) and they take up more space than cooler waters, raising sea 28 While the top of the ocean is well studied, its depths are more difficult to 29 The researchers gathered 150 years of ocean temperature data in order to get abetter 30 of heat absorption from surface to seabed. They gathered together temperature readings collected by everything from a 19th century 31 of British naval ships to modem automated ocean probes. The extensive data sources, 32 with computer simulations ( 计算机模拟), created a timeline of ocean temperature changes, including cooling from volcanic outbreaks and warming from fossil fuel 33
paragraphs.translationZh: 众所周知，变暖的海水会导致珊瑚白化，而且它们比较冷的海水占据更多的空间，导致海平面上升。虽然海洋顶部已得到充分研究，但其深处的探索却更加困难。研究人员收集了 150 年的海洋温度数据，以便更好地了解从表面到海底的热量吸收情况。他们收集了从 19 世纪英国海军舰艇航行到现代自动海洋探测器等各种方式收集的温度读数。广泛的数据源与计算机模拟（计算机模拟）相结合，创建了海洋温度变化的时间表，包括火山爆发造成的冷却和化石燃料排放造成的变暖

paragraphs.sourceText: About 35 percent of the heat taken in by the oceans during the industrial era now resides at a 34 of more than 700 meters, the researchers found. They say they're 35 whether the deep-sea warming canceled out warming at the sea's surface.
paragraphs.translationZh: 研究人员发现，工业时代海洋吸收的热量中约有 35% 现在位于 700 米以上的深度。他们表示不确定深海变暖是否抵消了海面变暖。

paragraphs.sourceText: The Secret to Raising Smart Kids
paragraphs.translationZh: 培养聪明孩子的秘诀

paragraphs.sourceText: A. I first began to investigate the basis of human motivation--and how people persevere after setbacks--as a psychology graduate student at Yale University in the 1960s. Animal experiments by psychologists at the University of Pennsylvania had shown that after repeated failures, most animals conclude that a situation is hopeless and beyond their control. After such an experience an animal often remains passive even when it can effect change--a state they called learned helplessness.
paragraphs.translationZh: 答：20 世纪 60 年代，我在耶鲁大学攻读心理学研究生时，首次开始研究人类动机的基础，以及人们如何在挫折后坚持下去。宾夕法尼亚大学心理学家进行的动物实验表明，在多次失败后，大多数动物都会得出结论，情况是没有希望的，超出了它们的控制范围。在经历了这样的经历之后，动物通常会保持被动，即使它可以带来改变——他们称之为习得性无助的状态。

paragraphs.sourceText: B. People can learn to be helpless, too. Why do some students give up when they encounter difficulty, whereas others who are no more skilled continue to strive and learn? One answer, I soon discovered, lay in people's beliefs about why they had failed.
paragraphs.translationZh: B. 人们也可以学会变得无助。为什么有些学生遇到困难就放弃，而另一些不熟练的学生却继续努力学习？我很快发现，答案之一在于人们对自己失败原因的信念。

paragraphs.sourceText: C. In particular, attributing poor performance to a lack of ability depresses motivation more than does the belief that lack of effort is to blame. When I told a group of school children who displayed helpless behavior that a lack of effort led to their mistakes in math, they learned to keep trying when the problems got tough. Another group of helpless children who were simply rewarded for their success on easier problems did not improve their ability to solve hard math problems. These experiments indicated that a focus on effort can help resolve helplessness and generate success.
paragraphs.translationZh: C. 特别是，将表现不佳归咎于缺乏能力比认为缺乏努力更能抑制积极性。当我告诉一群表现出无助行为的小学生，由于缺乏努力导致他们在数学上犯了错误时，他们学会了在问题变得棘手时继续尝试。另一组无助的孩子只是因为在较简单的问题上取得成功而获得奖励，但他们解决困难数学问题的能力并没有提高。这些实验表明，专注于努力可以帮助解决无助感并带来成功。

paragraphs.sourceText: D. Later, I developed a broader theory of what separates the two general classes of learners—helpless versus mastery-oriented. I realized these different types of students not only explain their failures differently, but they also hold different "theories" of intelligence. The helpless ones believe intelligence is a fixed characteristic: you have only a certain amount, and that's that. I call this a "fixed mind-set (思维模式). " Mistakes crack their self-confidence because they attribute errors to a lack of ability, which they feel powerless to change. They avoid challenges because challenges make mistakes more likely. The mastery-oriented children, on the other hand, think intelligence is not fixed and can be developed through education and hard work. Such children believe challenges are energizing rather than intimidating (令人生畏); they offer opportunities to learn. Students with such a growth mind-set were destined (注定) for greater academic success and were quite likely to outperform their counterparts.
paragraphs.translationZh: D. 后来，我发展了一个更广泛的理论来区分两种一般类型的学习者——无助型学习者和精通型学习者。我意识到这些不同类型的学生不仅以不同的方式解释他们的失败，而且他们也持有不同的智力“理论”。无助的人相信智力是一种固定的特征：你只有一定的数量，仅此而已。我称之为“思维模式”。错误会破坏他们的自信心，因为他们将错误归因于能力的缺乏，而他们感到无力改变。他们回避挑战，因为挑战更容易犯错误。另一方面，掌握型儿童认为智力不是固定的，可以通过教育和努力来发展。这些孩子相信挑战是令人生畏的，而不是令人生畏的。他们提供学习的机会。具有这种成长心态的学生注定会取得更大的学业成功，并且很有可能超越他们的同龄人。

paragraphs.sourceText: E. We validated these expectations in a study in which two other psychologists and I monitored 373students for two years during the transition to junior high school, when the work gets more difficult and the grading more strict, to determine how their mind-sets might affect their math grades. At the beginning of seventh grade, we assessed the students' mind-sets by asking them to agree or disagree with statements such as "Your intelligence is something very basic about you that you can't really change. " We then assessed their beliefs about other aspects of learning and looked to see what happened to their grades.
paragraphs.translationZh: E. 我们在一项研究中验证了这些期望，在这项研究中，我和另外两名心理学家对 373 名学生在初中过渡期间进行了两年的监测，当时的作业变得更加困难，评分也更加严格，以确定他们的心态如何影响他们的数学成绩。在七年级开始时，我们通过要求学生同意或不同意诸如“你的智力是你无法真正改变的非常基本的东西”之类的陈述来评估他们的心态。然后我们评估了他们对学习其他方面的信念，并观察他们的成绩发生了什么变化。

paragraphs.sourceText: F. As predicted, the students with a growth mind-set felt that learning was a more important goal than getting good grades. In addition, they held hard work in high regard. They understood that even geniuses have to work hard. Confronted by a setback such as a disappointing test grade, students with a growth mind-set said they would study harder or try a different strategy. The students who held a fixed mind-set, however, were concerned about looking smart with less regard for learning. They had negative views of effort, believing that having to work hard was a sign of low ability. They thought that a person with talent or intelligence did not need to work hard to do well. Attributing a bad grade to their own lack of ability, those with a fixed mind-set said that they would study less in the future, try never to take that subject again and consider cheating on future tests.
paragraphs.translationZh: F. 正如预测的那样，具有成长心态的学生认为学习是比取得好成绩更重要的目标。此外，他们还高度重视辛勤工作。他们明白，即使是天才也必须努力工作。面对考试成绩令人失望等挫折，具有成长心态的学生表示，他们会更加努力地学习或尝试不同的策略。然而，持有固定思维模式的学生则担心自己看起来很聪明，而不关心学习。他们对努力持负面看法，认为必须努力工作是能力低下的表现。他们认为，一个有才华或智慧的人不需要努力工作就能取得好成绩。那些有固定心态的人把成绩不好归咎于自己能力不够，表示以后会少读书，尽量不再考这门课，并考虑在以后的考试中作弊。

paragraphs.sourceText: G. Such different outlooks had a dramatic impact on performance. At the start of junior high, the math achievement test scores of the students with a growth mind-set were comparable to those of students who displayed a fixed mind-set. But as the work became more difficult, the students with a growth mind-set showed greater persistence. As a result, their math grades overtook those of the other students by the end of the first semester--and the gap between the two groups continued to widen during the two years we followed them.
paragraphs.translationZh: G. 这种不同的观点对绩效产生了巨大的影响。初中开始时，具有成长心态的学生的数学成绩测试成绩与表现出固定心态的学生相当。但随着工作变得越来越困难，具有成长心态的学生表现出了更大的毅力。结果，到第一学期结束时，他们的数学成绩就超过了其他学生，而在我们跟踪他们的两年里，两组之间的差距继续扩大。

paragraphs.sourceText: H. A fixed mind-set can also hinder communication and progress in the workplace and discourage or ignore constructive criticism and advice. Research shows that managers who have a fixed mind-set are less likely to seek or welcome feedback from their employees than are managers with a growth mind-set.
paragraphs.translationZh: H. 固定的心态也会阻碍工作场所的沟通和进步，阻碍或忽视建设性的批评和建议。研究表明，与具有成长型思维模式的管理者相比，具有固定型思维模式的管理者不太可能寻求或欢迎员工的反馈。

paragraphs.sourceText: I. How do we transmit a growth mind-set to our children? One way is by telling stories about achievements that result from hard work. For instance, talking about mathematical geniuses who were more or less born that way puts students in a fixed mind-set, but descriptions of great mathematicians who fell in love with math and developed amazing skills produce a growth mind-set.
paragraphs.translationZh: 一、我们如何向孩子传递成长心态？一种方法是讲述努力工作所取得的成就的故事。例如，谈论或多或少与生俱来的数学天才会让学生陷入一种固定的心态，但描述爱上数学并发展出惊人技能的伟大数学家会产生一种成长心态。

paragraphs.sourceText: J. In addition, parents and teachers can help children by providing explicit instruction regarding the mind as a learning machine. I designed an eight-session workshop for 91 students whose math grades were declining in their first year of junior high. Forty-eight of the students received instruction in study skills only, whereas the others attended a combination of study skills sessions and classes in which they learned about the growth mind-set and how to apply it to schoolwork. In the growth mind-set classes, students read and discussed an article entitled "You Can Grow Your Brain. " They were taught that the brain is like a muscle that gets stronger with use and that learning prompts the brain to grow new connections. From such instruction, many students began to see themselves as agents of their own brain development. Despite being unaware that there were two types of instruction, teachers reported significant motivational changes in 27% of the children in the growth mind-set workshop as compared with only 9% of students in the control group.
paragraphs.translationZh: J. 此外，父母和老师可以通过提供关于思维作为学习机器的明确指导来帮助孩子。我为 91 名初中一年级数学成绩下降的学生设计了一个为期八节的研讨会。其中 48 名学生仅接受了学习技能方面的指导，而其他学生则参加了学习技能课程和课程的结合，在课程中他们了解了成长心态以及如何将其应用到学业中。在成长心态课程中，学生们阅读并讨论了一篇题为“你可以培养你的大脑”的文章。他们被教导说，大脑就像一块肌肉，随着使用而变得更强，学习会促使大脑建立新的联系。通过这样的指导，许多学生开始将自己视为自己大脑发展的推动者。尽管不知道有两种类型的教学，但教师报告说，在成长心态研讨会中，27% 的学生的动机发生了显着变化，而对照组中只有 9% 的学生发生了显着的动机变化。

paragraphs.sourceText: K. Research is converging (汇聚) on the conclusion that great accomplishment and even genius is typically the result of years of passion and dedication and not something that flows naturally from a gift.
paragraphs.translationZh: K. 研究汇聚了这样的结论：伟大的成就甚至天才通常是多年热情和奉献的结果，而不是自然而然的天赋。

paragraphs.sourceText: 36. The author's experiment shows that students with a fixed mind-set believe having to work hard is an indication of low ability.
paragraphs.translationZh: 36. 作者的实验表明，具有固定心态的学生认为，必须努力工作是能力低下的表现。

paragraphs.sourceText: 37. Focusing on effort is effective in helping children overcome frustration and achieve success.
paragraphs.translationZh: 37. 专注于努力可以有效帮助儿童克服挫折并取得成功。

paragraphs.sourceText: 38. We can cultivate a growth mind-set in children by telling success stories that emphasize hard work and love of learning.
paragraphs.translationZh: 38. 我们可以通过讲述强调努力工作和热爱学习的成功故事来培养孩子们的成长心态。

paragraphs.sourceText: 39. Students' belief about the cause of their failure explains their attitude toward setbacks.
paragraphs.translationZh: 39. 学生对失败原因的信念解释了他们对挫折的态度。

paragraphs.sourceText: 40. In the author's experiment, students with a growth mind-set showed greater perseverance in solving difficult math problems.
paragraphs.translationZh: 40. 在作者的实验中，具有成长心态的学生在解决困难的数学问题时表现出更大的毅力。

paragraphs.sourceText: 41. The author conducted an experiment to find out about the influence of students' mind-sets on math learning.
paragraphs.translationZh: 41. 作者进行了一项实验来了解学生的心态对数学学习的影响。

paragraphs.sourceText: 42. After failing again and again, most animals give up hope.
paragraphs.translationZh: 42.在一次又一次的失败之后，大多数动物都放弃了希望。

paragraphs.sourceText: 43. Informing students about the brain as a learning machine is a good strategy to enhance their motivation for learning.
paragraphs.translationZh: 43. 让学生了解大脑是一台学习机器是增强他们学习动机的一个好策略。

paragraphs.sourceText: 44. People with a fixed mind-set believe that one's intelligence is unchangeable.
paragraphs.translationZh: 44. 具有固定心态的人相信自己的智力是不可改变的。

paragraphs.sourceText: 45. In the workplace, feedback may not be so welcome to managers with a fixed mind-set.
paragraphs.translationZh: 45. 在工作场所，具有固定思维模式的管理者可能不太欢迎反馈。

paragraphs.sourceText: Questions 46 to 50 are based on the following passage.
paragraphs.translationZh: 第 46 至 50 题基于以下段落。

paragraphs.sourceText: "Sugar, alcohol and tobacco," economist Adam Smith once wrote," are commodities which are nowhere necessaries of life, which have become objects of almost universal consumption, and which are, therefore, extremely popular subjects of taxation. "
paragraphs.translationZh: 经济学家亚当·斯密曾经写道：“糖、酒精和烟草这些商品根本不是生活必需品，它们几乎已成为普遍消费的对象，因此也是极受欢迎的征税对象。”

paragraphs.sourceText: Two and a haft centuries on, most countries impose some sort of tax on alcohol and tobacco. With surging obesity levels putting increasing strain on public health systems, governments around the world have begun to toy with the idea of taxing sugar as well.
paragraphs.translationZh: 两个半世纪过去了，大多数国家都对酒精和烟草征收某种税。随着肥胖水平的飙升给公共卫生系统带来越来越大的压力，世界各国政府也开始考虑对糖征税的想法。

paragraphs.sourceText: Whether such taxes work is a matter of debate. A preliminary review of Mexico's taxation found a fall in purchases of taxed drinks as well as a rise in sales of untaxed and healthier drinks. By contrast, a Danish tax on foods high in fats was abandoned a year after its introduction, amid claims that consumers were avoiding it by crossing the border to Germany to satisfy their desire for cheaper, fattier fare.
paragraphs.translationZh: 这种税收是否有效仍存在争议。对墨西哥税​​收的初步审查发现，征税饮料的购买量下降，而免税和健康饮料的销量则有所增加。相比之下，丹麦对高脂肪食品征税在实施一年后就被放弃了，因为有传言称，消费者为了避免征税而越过边境前往德国，以满足他们对更便宜、更油腻的食物的渴望。

paragraphs.sourceText: The food industry has, in general, been firmly opposed to such direct government action. Nonetheless, the renewed focus on waistlines means that industry groups are under pressure to demonstrate their products are healthy as well as tasty.
paragraphs.translationZh: 食品行业总体上坚决反对政府的这种直接行动。尽管如此，对腰围的重新关注意味着行业团体面临着展示其产品健康和美味的压力。

paragraphs.sourceText: Over the past three decades, the industry has made some efforts to improve the quality of its offerings. For example, some drink manufacturers have cut the amount of sugar in their beverages.
paragraphs.translationZh: 在过去的三十年中，该行业为提高产品质量做出了一些努力。例如，一些饮料制造商减少了饮料中的糖含量。

paragraphs.sourceText: Many of the reductions over the past 30 years have been achieved either by reducing the amount of sugar, salt or fat in a product, or by finding an alternative ingredient. More recently, however, some companies have been investing money in a more ambitious undertaking: learning how to adjust the fundamental make-up of the food they sell. For example, having salt on the outside, but none on the inside, reduces the salt content without changing the taste.
paragraphs.translationZh: 过去 30 年来，许多减排措施都是通过减少产品中糖、盐或脂肪的含量，或通过寻找替代成分来实现的。然而，最近，一些公司一直在投资一项更雄心勃勃的事业：学习如何调整他们销售的食品的基本构成。例如，外面加盐，里面不加盐，既减少了盐含量，又不改变味道。

paragraphs.sourceText: While reformulating recipes ( 配方) is one way to improve public health, it should be part of a multi-sided approach. The key is to remember that there is not just one solution. To deal with obesity, mixture of approaches--including reformulation, taxation and adjusting portion sizes--will be needed. There is no silver bullet.
paragraphs.translationZh: 虽然重新制定食谱是改善公共卫生的一种方法，但它应该是多边方法的一部分。关键是要记住，解决方案不只有一种。为了解决肥胖问题，需要采取多种方法，包括重新配制、征税和调整份量。没有灵丹妙药。

paragraphs.sourceText: You may have heard some of the fashion industry horror stories: models eating tissues or cotton balls to hold off hunger, and models collapsing from hunger-induced heart attacks just seconds after they step off the runway.
paragraphs.translationZh: 您可能听说过一些时尚界的恐怖故事：模特吃纸巾或棉球来抵御饥饿，模特在走下跑道几秒钟后就因饥饿引发的心脏病而倒下。

paragraphs.sourceText: Excessively skinny models have been a point of controversy for decades, and two researchers say a model's body mass should be a workplace health and safety issue. In an editorial released Monday in the American Journal of Public Health, Katherine Record and Bryn Austin made their case for government regulation of the fashion industry.
paragraphs.translationZh: 几十年来，模特过瘦一直是争议的焦点，两名研究人员表示，模特的体重应该是工作场所的健康和安全问题。在《美国公共卫生杂志》周一发表的一篇社论中，凯瑟琳·记录 (Katherine Record) 和布林·奥斯汀 (Bryn Austin) 阐述了政府对时尚业进行监管的理由。

paragraphs.sourceText: The average international runway model has a body mass index (BMI) under 16--low enough to indicate starvation by the World Health Organization's standard. And Record and Austin are worried not just about the models themselves, but about the vast number of girls and women their images influence.
paragraphs.translationZh: 国际跑道模特的平均体重指数 (BMI) 低于 16，按照世界卫生组织的标准，该指数低得足以表明处于饥饿状态。记录和奥斯汀不仅担心模特本身，还担心她们的形象影响的大量女孩和女性。

paragraphs.sourceText: "Especially girls and teens," says Record. "Seventy percent of girls aged 10 to 18 report that they define perfect body image based on what they see in magazines. " That's especially worrying, she says, given that anorexia (厌食症) results in more deaths than does any other mental illness, according to the National Institute of Mental Health.
paragraphs.translationZh: “尤其是女孩和青少年，”记录说。 “百分之七十的 10 至 18 岁女孩表示，她们根据在杂志上看到的内容来定义完美的身体形象。”她说，鉴于厌食症导致的死亡人数比任何其他精神疾病都要多，这尤其令人担忧。

paragraphs.sourceText: It's commonly known that certain diseases are linked with occupations like lung disease in coalminers. Professional fashion models are particularly vulnerable to eating disorders resulting from occupational demands to maintain extreme thinness.
paragraphs.translationZh: 众所周知，某些疾病与职业有关，例如煤矿工人的肺病。职业时装模特特别容易受到饮食失调的影响，因为职业要求要保持极度苗条。

paragraphs.sourceText: Record's suggestion is to prohibit agents from hiring models with a BMI below 18.
paragraphs.translationZh: Record的建议是禁止代理商雇用BMI低于18的模特。

paragraphs.sourceText: In April, France passed a law setting lower limits for a model's weight. Agents and fashion houses who hire models with a BMI under 18 could pay $ 82,000 in fines and spend up to 6 months in jail. Regulating the fashion industry in the United States won't be easy, Record says. But with the new rules in France, U.S. support could make a difference. "A designer can't survive without participating in Paris Fashion Week", she says, adding," Our argument is that the same would be true of New York Fashion Week. "
paragraphs.translationZh: 四月，法国通过了一项法律，规定了模特体重的下限。雇用体重指数 (BMI) 低于 18 岁模特的代理商和时装公司可能会被处以 82,000 美元的罚款，并被处以最高 6 个月的监禁。 Record 表示，监管美国时尚业并不容易。但随着法国的新规定，美国的支持可能会产生影响。 “设计师如果不参加巴黎时装周就无法生存，”她说道，并补充道，“我们的观点是，纽约时装周也是如此。”
